import re


def slugify(s):
    """Convert a string to a URL-friendly slug.

    Lowercases the input, replaces any run of non-alphanumeric characters
    with a single hyphen, and strips leading/trailing hyphens.
    """
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")

import sys, re, importlib.util, traceback

# Load the module under test
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('text', 'text.py')
mod  = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
slugify = mod.slugify

cases = [
    ('Hello World',        'hello-world'),
    ('UPPER CASE',         'upper-case'),
    ('café & résumé!',     'caf-r-sum'),
    ('too   many   spaces','too-many-spaces'),
    ('Hello, World!',      'hello-world'),
    ('--hello--',          'hello'),
    ('Python 3.11 Release','python-3-11-release'),
    ('already-a-slug',     'already-a-slug'),
    ('',                   ''),
]

passed = failed = 0
for inp, expected in cases:
    got = slugify(inp)
    if got == expected:
        print(f'  PASS  slugify({inp!r}) == {expected!r}')
        passed += 1
    else:
        print(f'  FAIL  slugify({inp!r}): expected {expected!r}, got {got!r}')
        failed += 1

print(f'\n{passed} passed, {failed} failed')
sys.exit(0 if failed == 0 else 1)
"
